message.content:
I’m not able to look up live locations or access your device’s GPS, so I don’t have a way to tell you which Italian spot is physically nearest right now.  

Here are some quick ways you can find the best option nearby:

| Method | How to do it |
|--------|--------------|
| **Google Maps** (or Apple/MapQuest) | Search “Italian restaurant” + your city / zip code. It will list places with distance, ratings, hours, and directions. |
| **Yelp** | Enter “Italian” and filter by “Near me.” You’ll see reviews, photos, and sometimes price ranges. |
| **TripAdvisor** | Similar search; useful if you’re traveling outside your hometown. |
| **Ask Siri/Alexa/Google Assistant** | Say something like “Find the nearest Italian restaurant,” and they’ll pull up options based on your current location. |

If you let me know what city or neighborhood you’re in, I can point out a few well‑rated spots there—just keep in mind those suggestions won’t reflect real‑time traffic or opening hours.
